@dataclass
class CacheEntry:
    """
    Represents a single entry in the LRU cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The unique identifier for the cache entry
        value: The cached value
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created
        last_accessed: Timestamp of the last access
        ttl: Time-to-live in seconds (None means no expiry)
        status: Current status of the entry
    """
    key: Any
    value: Any
    created_at: float
    last_accessed: float
    ttl: Optional[float]
    status: CacheStatus = CacheStatus.ACTIVE

    def is_expired(self) -> bool:
        """Check if this entry has expired based on its TTL."""
        if self.ttl is None:
            return False
        current_time = time.time()
        return (current_time - self.last_accessed) >= self.ttl

    def age(self) -> float:
        """Return the age of this entry in seconds."""
        return time.time() - self.last_accessed

    def remaining_ttl(self) -> Optional[float]:
        """Return the remaining time-to-live, or None if no TTL is set."""
        if self.ttl is None:
            return None
        elapsed = time.time() - self.last_accessed
        return max(0.0, self.ttl - elapsed)
